name: sevyware
description: SEVYWARE is a medium‑sophistication criminal ransomware group that conducts organized extortion and double‑extortion campaigns across a broad range of industries, including critical infrastructure and high‑profile government entities. They leverage cloud resources, public web services, and sophisticated Kubernetes manipulation for stealthy persistence and lateral movement while delivering malware through paid online ads and phishing.”,”enhanced_description":"SEVYWARE (also referred to as APT43, BlackCat, Royal Ransomware, and others) has emerged as a major ransomware threat that combines advanced cloud‑based delivery techniques with traditional social‑engineering tactics. They also develop a proprietary malware ecosystem—comprising droppers, post‑compromise modules, image‑based backdoors, custom C2 protocols, and packers—to tailor attacks to each target’s environment. SEVYWARE conducts extensive reconnaissance through IP block scanning, vulnerability assessment, brute‑force content discovery, and active threat‑hunting techniques before deploying ransomware payloads. Once inside an organization, they frequently employ internal spearphishing and compromised social‑media or email accounts to expand lateral reach.
